Amos asked for Turok, a Turo AI agent that manages his Turo account: sets prices, messages guests, all of it. Turok was built inside Akira (akira/TUROK.md, src/cycles/turok.ts). Turok reads Turo emails from Gmail, tracks cars/trips/guest messages, writes guest replies and lifecycle messages, accepts/declines requests, reprices every car daily, and sets claim/reimbursement reminders. Outward Turo actions are queued in the Turo outbox and pushed to Amos to apply, because Turo has no public host API and no Turo login has been granted (rules/autonomy.md).
